title: (chore) Migrate from jest to vitest
body:

## Summary

Migrates stock-management's test runner from jest to vitest, aligning it with the patterns adopted by `openmrs-esm-core`, `openmrs-esm-billing-app`, and the other in-flight migrations across the O3 apps.

Changes:
- Replace `jest`, `@swc/jest`, `jest-cli`, `jest-environment-jsdom`, and `@types/jest` with `vitest`, `@vitest/coverage-v8`, `jsdom`, and `cross-env`. Bump `@testing-library/dom` (10.4.0 to 10.4.1) and `@testing-library/jest-dom` (5.x to 6.x) so the `/vitest` subpath is available.
- Add `vitest.config.ts` with the standard O3 vitest setup: `jsdom` environment, `.scss`/`.css` aliased to `identity-obj-proxy` with an anchored `^.*\.s?css$` regex, `@openmrs/esm-framework` aliased to its mock, `react-i18next` aliased to the local `__mocks__` file, `@mocks` alias for the path shortcut already in use, and `fakeTimers.toFake` limited to the timers we actually fake (excludes `queueMicrotask` which otherwise breaks React's scheduler).
- Add `tools/setup-tests.ts` to load `@testing-library/jest-dom/vitest` (which is enough for tsc to pick up the matcher type extension), register `afterEach(cleanup)`, and rewrite the `ResizeObserver` mock as a class (Carbon's `TextArea` calls it with `new`).
- Convert the eighteen test files to the vitest API: explicit imports for `describe`/`expect`/`it`/`test`/`vi` (plus `beforeEach` where used), `jest.*` swapped for `vi.*`, `jest.Mock` type alias replaced with `Mock` from vitest. Inline component factories of the form `vi.mock(name, () => () => <jsx />)` wrapped in `{ default: ... }` since vitest requires the factory to return a module object. The `vi.mock('./hooks/useParties', () => vi.fn())` factory similarly wrapped to expose a default export.
- Update the danger-button selector in `stock-sources-delete.test.tsx` to `/danger\s*delete/i`: the newer testing-library no longer joins the visually-hidden "danger" prefix and the visible "Delete" with a space when computing the accessible name.
- Delete `jest.config.js`.
